Why do your ears pop on a plane? ✈️👂 Behind each eardrum is a tiny pocket of air. When the cabin pressure drops, it pushes your eardrum out, and a swallow or yawn opens a tiny tube so the pressure evens out: POP! That's why chewing gum helps. Follow for a weird true fact every day 🧠
